gate_results.rationale: The document makes many load-bearing factual and quantitative claims (e.g., 'Set theory pays nine axioms', 'Gravity is 10^36 weaker than electromagnetism', 'Strong nuclear force is 137 times stronger than electromagnetism', 'The cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120', 'The Hubble Tension is a 5-sigma discrepancy', 'The Hessian matrix ... scored this variable as the most connected node in the entire system') without any traceable citations, derivations, or data. The source itself acknowledges the mappings are not yet adversarially tested (S402), but the body text presents them as established. No evidence items can be cited for these claims beyond the assertions themselves.

Several tensions are present but mostly acknowledged and bounded rather than load-bearing and unresolved. The document explicitly states the argument could be wrong (S225), that the match could be coincidence (S226), and that a skeptic could write the opposite essay (S227). However, the claim that the axiom 'cannot be proven' is simultaneously a 'signature' of a genuine Layer 0 (S040-S045) and that 'Godel guarantees it' (S048, S311) is a strong, unproven assertion that functions as a load-bearing claim while being presented as settled. The contradiction between 'physics is not allowed to smuggle in theology' (S282) and the extensive theological reading of physical forces (S139, S149, S235-S245) is acknowledged as a 'bridge' (S401) but the bridge validity is not established. These are local and acknowledged, not fully resolved.
gate_results.resolution: The document acknowledges the limits of its claims in S225-S230 and S401-S402, but the Godel claim remains an unresolved load-bearing assertion.

It acknowledges that physics 'does not say why the world has those features' (S400) and that the bridge is 'declared' not proven (S401). However, the conclusion that the ten laws 'describe a Person' (S259) and that 'only one Person in history matches it' (S130) exceeds what the evidence and method can support. gate_results.rationale: The document explicitly names kill conditions: 'a force with no matching structure' (S410) and states that the argument could be wrong (S225). It says it 'names its own kill conditions in advance, out loud, so anyone can check' (S230). This is a genuine attempt at falsifiability, though the kill conditions are broad and the document does not specify what evidence would count against the Godel claim or the necessary ground argument.

The document makes extensive cross-domain claims mapping physical laws to spiritual concepts (S235-S245) and divine attributes (S299-S306). The bridge is asserted rather than validated.

The document has a metadata block with a source SHA256 and an original file path (front matter), and it cites biblical passages (e.g., S078, S141, S155, S162, S174, S207, S216). However, the quantitative claims (S132, S143, S151, S360, S365) lack citations to specific papers, datasets, or derivations. The Hessian matrix claim (S151) is particularly opaque. The provenance of the core argument is traceable to the author's framework but not to external evidence.

atoms.title: GOD AS ROOT - Long Edition
atoms.summary: Long-form source edition arguing the Trinitarian God is the single unprovable Layer-0 axiom paying four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation); physics is the created medium/grammar for love, choice, and grace; ten physical laws compose a portrait matching Christ with agency as the repeated structural gap; the framework inverts 'God of the gaps' by reading God in the completions, names kill conditions in advance, and lays out the Cross-Resolution method, the 24-step Descent, progressive revelation, and the canon reading order.

atoms.name: The Trinity Is the Single Ground Axiom
atoms.statementTechnical: The Trinitarian God (aseity, perichoresis, love) is the one Layer-0 axiom from which existence, distinction, relation, and orientation derive; it is unprovable by design (DG1).
atoms.statementPlain: God is the floor beneath everything; you can't prove Him because a provable axiom would rest on something deeper.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Demonstrate a deeper ground from which the Trinity derives, or show the four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are derivable without it.
atoms.notes: Four debts: existence, distinction, relation, orientation.

atoms.name: Physics Is the Created Medium, Not God
atoms.statementTechnical: Physics is the ordered created medium enabling relation, consequence, choice, time, repair, embodiment, and love to be publicly meaningful; it is not grace and not the Creator.
atoms.statementPlain: Physics is the grammar God speaks so creatures can exist, choose, and be redeemed — not God, not grace.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show a world where love, choice, consequence, and repair are real without any lawful physical medium, or show physics is identical to grace/God.

atoms.name: Ten Laws Compose a Portrait of Christ
atoms.statementTechnical: Measured properties of ten physical structures (gravity, strong force, EM, mass-energy, thermodynamics, information, relativity, QM, weak force, coherence) read together compose a specific personal portrait; agency is the identical missing variable in all ten.
atoms.statementPlain: Read the ten laws together and they describe one Person; the same gap — agency — appears ten times.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Produce a force whose measured properties have no matching spiritual structure, or show the ten mappings are arbitrary/coincidental under adversarial test.

atoms.name: God in the Completions, Not the Gaps
atoms.statementTechnical: The framework reads ten fully explained laws, not unexplained gaps; the more science explains, the clearer the portrait, so it does not bet on science failing.
atoms.statementPlain: God isn't hiding in what we don't know; He's written into what we do know.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show that the portrait depends on scientific ignorance, i.e., that fuller explanation dissolves the structural match.

atoms.name: The Necessary Ground Argument
atoms.statementTechnical: If closed systems decay and the universe persists, an external source must be necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active, and personal; these map to aseity, self-sufficiency, eternality, omnipresence, Logos, providence, personhood.
atoms.statementPlain: The universe needs a source outside itself that is necessary, self-grounding, active, and personal — the God theologians already described.
atoms.falsificationCondition: Show the universe is a closed system that sustains itself, or that the five required properties are jointly incoherent or unnecessary.

source_selection.exact_source_expression: God is the floor beneath everything; you can't prove Him because a provable axiom would rest on something deeper.
source_selection.reason: The claim has a precise formal shape: an unprovable ground axiom for a derivation system, with a meta-theorem that provability of the ground would contradict its foundational role. This is expressible in Lean 4 using a small axiomatic derivation system and a predicate for 'is the ground'.

formal_object.exact_proposed_statement: For any derivation system D with a distinguished ground axiom G, if G is the unique axiom of D and D is sound, then there is no derivation in D of G from the empty set of premises; moreover, if G were derivable from some proper subsystem, G would not be the ground.

symbol_table.formal_definition:
structure DerivationSystem where
  Formula : Type
  Axiom : Formula → Prop
  Derives : Set Formula → Formula → Prop
  sound : ∀ {Γ φ}, Derives Γ φ → (∀ ψ ∈ Γ, True) → True
symbol_table.reader_meaning: A formal system with formulas, axioms, and a derivability relation.
symbol_table.source_correspondence: The paper's 'formal system' with a floor it cannot dig beneath (S010).

symbol_table.formal_definition: def GroundAxiom (D : DerivationSystem) (G : D.Formula) : Prop := D.Axiom G ∧ ∀ φ, D.Axiom φ → φ = G
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The single axiom on which the system rests.
symbol_table.source_correspondence: The Trinity as the single ground axiom (A01, S015–S022).

symbol_table.formal_definition: def UnprovableFromEmpty (D : DerivationSystem) (G : D.Formula) : Prop := ¬ D.Derives ∅ G
symbol_table.reader_meaning: The ground axiom cannot be derived from no premises.

explicit_premises: D is a derivation system with a distinguished formula G.
G is the unique axiom of D.
D is sound in the sense that derivability from premises implies truth under any valuation satisfying the premises.

assumptions_and_dependencies.non_vacuity_requirement: There must exist at least one derivation system with a unique axiom; e.g., the trivial system with one axiom and no rules.

stories.plot_or_sequence: Every formal system has a floor it cannot dig beneath. Set theory pays nine axioms, Peano arithmetic five, general relativity two postulates. This framework pays one: God. The Trinitarian God pays four debts no other ontology pays: existence, distinction, relation, orientation. The axiom cannot be proven, and that is the signature of a genuine Layer 0.

stories.title_or_label: The Descent: 24 Steps to the Cross
stories.setting_or_context: The causal chain from God to the Cross
stories.plot_or_sequence: God creates. Creation stands. What stands is distinguishable. Distinction makes being intelligible. What is intelligible carries information. What carries information can stand in relation. What can stand in relation can be kept or broken. Therefore relation reveals value. What has value can be regarded rightly or wrongly. Thus value opens moral valence. Moral valence makes right and wrong meaningful. Right and wrong require agents who can choose. Choice requires a world of rules, limits, time, and consequences. Such a world permits decay, vulnerability, and loss. Decay and vulnerability open the possibility of adversarial refusal of coherence. The Enemy is that agency of refusal. Adversarial action creates real debt, damage, and disorder. Perfect Justice requires that this be truthfully answered and paid. Perfect Mercy wills restoration rather than abandonment. Justice and Mercy together require a cost-bearing source beyond the damaged order itself. That source must preserve truth while making restoration possible. That source is Grace. Grace restores creation toward God. Christ is the convergence point where justice, mercy, truth, and restoration meet.
stories.emotional_or_rhetorical_load: High; builds to a theological climax

boundaries.what_it_does_not_show: That each step is logically necessary, or that the conclusion follows without additional theological assumptions.
boundaries.what_would_falsify_the_narrative: A step in the chain that does not follow, or a demonstration that the chain can be broken without contradiction.

Plate tectonics. Neuroscience. The gaps close. This paper does the opposite: it takes ten things science DID explain and shows that when you read them together, they describe a Person. Those properties have had a name for thousands of years: Aseity, Self-sufficiency, Eternality, Omnipresence, Logos, Providence, Personhood. master_equation.one_line: The paper's single Trinitarian axiom functions as a multiplicative ground analogous to the master equation's product of factors, with strong direct fits for G, M, E, S_eff, T, R, and C, and analogous fits for K, Q, and F, though agency appears as an extra factor not in the original equation.
breaks: The paper treats agency as a necessary variable that the physics does not need but the spiritual reading does; this is an added factor with no slot in the master equation, and it is the repeated structural gap.

The product test is multiplicative for the axiom, but the paper also allows for the possibility that the whole argument could be wrong, which introduces an additive or probabilistic element not captured by a strict product.
The slot G is filled by God as external source, but the paper also says physics is not God and physics is the created medium; this creates a potential conflation between the source and the medium.

The paper treats 'agency' as a required extra factor with no dedicated slot in the master equation; it is the repeated missing piece in all ten law mappings, but the canonical slot list has no A for agency.

The paper's product test is stated for the root axiom, not for the full χ product; several downstream factors (e.g., physics as medium) are described as necessary conditions rather than multiplicative contributors.
The slot K (compression) is only analogically present: the paper speaks of grammar, language, and Logos, but does not frame this as compression or compressibility in the Shannon sense.
The slot Q (superposition) is stretched: the paper's 'open possibility' is theological agency, not quantum superposition, and the paper does not use quantum formalism to ground it.

The paper adds 'narrative' and 'progressive revelation' as a temporal pedagogy that has no direct slot; it functions as a meta-factor shaping how T is received rather than as a separate multiplicative term.

The Cross-Resolution Method: a meta-method for testing claims across registers, which is not itself a factor in the equation but governs how factors are assessed.

master_equation_b.notes: The paper references 'The Master Equation' only as a title in the Canon Reading Order (S393), calling it 'the formal center' of the series. No mathematical expression or formal structure of the master equation is provided in this paper. The paper's mathematical content consists of: (1) standard physics equations and constants (E=mc^2, Maxwell's equations, Second Law, force ratios, fine-tuning, Hubble tension); (2) qualitative causal chains (24-step Descent); (3) mapping tables between physics and theology; and (4) a claimed Hessian matrix computation whose details are not shown. The relationship to the master equation is therefore not_assessable from this paper alone. The paper's own framework claims a single axiom (Trinity) and a derivation grammar (DG1, CDR) but does not present the master equation itself.

overall.summary: The paper is internally coherent in its core theological and methodological moves, but its central bridge claim—that ten physical laws compose a portrait of Christ with agency as the repeated gap—is asserted rather than derived, and several key terms (agency, coherence, the ten laws) remain underdefined.

dimensions.name: internal_consistency
reasons: The core axiom (A01/S015-S022) is consistently treated as unprovable and foundational throughout (S040-S045, S310-S312), and this is explicitly reconciled with the derivation grammar (S044).

The distinction between physics as created medium and grace as external rescue is maintained consistently (A02/S056-S058, S113-S121), avoiding the obvious contradiction of equating gravity with grace.

The 'God in the completions, not the gaps' claim (A04/S259-S264) is consistently opposed to the 'God of the gaps' argument (S252-S258), and the kill conditions (A13/S225-S230) are stated in a way that does not contradict the framework's falsifiability commitment (S411).

However, there is a local tension between the claim that the ten-law portrait is 'checkable' (S123) and the admission that physics 'does not tell you WHY' (S129) and that the match 'could be coincidence' (S226). This is acknowledged as an honest limit, but it weakens the consistency of the 'checkable' framing.

The necessary ground argument (A05/S290-S297) lists five required properties, but the paper elsewhere refers to 'five mathematical proofs' (S308, S402) without presenting them, creating a minor internal gap between claim and support.

dimensions.name: definitional_stability
reasons: Key terms are introduced but not rigorously defined: 'agency' is central to the ten-law mapping (S246-S249) yet never given a precise definition beyond being 'the missing piece' that the spiritual reading needs.
'Coherence' is used both as a physical law (S245) and as a general concept (S291, S295) without a stable definition linking the two uses.
The 'ten laws' are listed in a table (S235-S245) but the criteria for selecting exactly these ten, and for treating them as a complete set, are not specified.

'Bridge' is defined operationally in the Cross-Resolution Method (S281, S287) as a marked structural correspondence, which is a stable usage, but the strength criteria for bridges remain vague ('name its strength, state its limits').
Theological terms like 'aseity' and 'perichoresis' are defined (S020-S021), which is a strength, but the mapping from these to the four debts (S032-S036) is asserted rather than derived.

dimensions.name: inferential_connectedness
reasons: The Descent (A06/S315-S338) presents a 24-step causal chain with explicit claims of no smuggled premises (S339-S341), and the steps are sequentially connected, though several steps rely on contested metaphysical assumptions (e.g., S322 'relation reveals value', S325 'moral valence makes right and wrong meaningful').

The necessary ground argument (S290-S297) moves from premises about closed systems and coherence to five required properties, then maps these to theological terms (S299-S306); the inferential link is analogical rather than deductive, which the paper acknowledges as a 'bridge' (S401).

The ten-law portrait (S235-S245) is the weakest inferential link: the paper asserts that reading the properties together 'compose a portrait' (S130) and that 'only one Person in history matches it' (S130), but does not show how the properties uniquely determine that Person or rule out other matches.

The claim that 'the math said it without being asked' regarding the Hessian matrix (S151-S156) is presented as evidence but the connection between the matrix result and the theological conclusion is not inferentially spelled out.

The progressive revelation argument (A07/S343-S354) is internally coherent as an analogy to teaching, but the inference from 'God teaches like a teacher' to the specific historical sequence of revelation is not fully warranted.

dimensions.name: register_boundary_respect
reasons: The Cross-Resolution Method (A08/S276-S288) explicitly separates theology, physics, mathematics, lived reality, and bridge, and states rules against smuggling (S282-S285).

The paper repeatedly marks when it is making a bridge claim rather than a proof claim (S401 'The bridge is structural correspondence, not proof'; S400 'Physics describes the features... it does not say why').
The status table (S397-S402) honestly rates physics as 'modest' and mathematics as 'partially formalized', which respects register boundaries.

However, there are moments where the boundary is blurred: the empty tomb is called a 'physics claim' (A09/S220-S223) while also being a miracle claim, and the distinction between the two registers is not fully maintained.

The claim that 'the math gave us all the tools to find Him' (S309) and that 'those same tools prove they cannot prove Him' (S310) mixes mathematical and theological registers in a way that could be seen as a boundary violation, though it is presented as a meta-claim about the limits of formal systems.

contradictions.description: The paper claims the ten-law portrait is 'checkable' (S123) and that the match is specific enough that 'only one Person in history matches it' (S130), but also admits the match 'could be coincidence' (S226) and that a skeptic could write the opposite essay (S227). This is not a strict logical contradiction because the paper frames the match as defeasible evidence, but the rhetorical force of 'checkable' and 'only one Person' sits in tension with the acknowledged possibility of coincidence.

The necessary ground argument is said to have 'five proofs' (S308, S402), but the paper only lists five required properties (S293-S297) and maps them to theological terms (S299-S306); no proofs are actually presented. This is a gap between the claim of formalization and the content provided, bordering on a definitional inconsistency about what 'proof' means here.

tensions.description: Physics is described as the created medium that is 'not grace' (S117), yet the empty tomb is presented as a physics claim about entropy reversal from outside (S223). The tension is whether an event that is explicitly a divine intervention can be properly called a 'physics claim' without collapsing the medium/grace distinction.

The 'God in the completions' argument (S259-S264) is meant to be robust against scientific progress, but the kill condition that 'a force with no matching structure' would falsify the framework (S410) leaves open the possibility that future science could reveal such a force, which would put God back in a gap-like position.

The Trinity is presented as the single ground axiom (A01), while the necessary ground argument (A05) arrives at a set of properties that are then mapped to theological terms. The tension is whether the necessary ground argument is an independent proof that supports the axiom or a restatement of it, which affects the claim that the axiom cannot be proven.

missing_definitions.description: Central to the ten-law mapping as the repeated missing piece (S246-S249), but never defined precisely. It is unclear whether agency means libertarian free will, the capacity for choice, or something else, and how it is supposed to be 'checkable' in the physical laws.
Used as a physical law (S245) and as a general concept (S291, S295), but no definition is given for either use, nor is the relationship between them explained.
Listed in a table (S235-S245) but the selection criteria and the claim that these ten are the relevant set are not justified.
Operationally defined as a marked structural correspondence (S281, S287), but the criteria for what counts as a strong vs. weak bridge are not specified.
Referenced (S308, S402) but not presented or cited, leaving the claim of formalization unsupported.

coherence.notes: The paper is a long-form source edition explicitly marked as candidate, not canonized (S003-S005), which contextualizes its exploratory and sometimes assertive tone. The coherence assessment reflects the paper's own acknowledgment of open items (S402). The score is not a judgment of truth or falsity, but of how well the claims, definitions, and assumptions work together internally.
